model: K128, 128 output rows, 32 stages/unit, two compute WGs, FT_T64, 264 resident CTAs, parent cost tables.
invariants: Every logical stage assigned exactly once; empty partitions are valid.
Each split unit's partial counts sum to 32.
Inverse fixup owner is the CTA actually containing stage zero, even with rounded/empty partitions.
Distinct split units do not alias one CTA boundary slot within a phase.
Phase-B designated-finisher waits point only to strictly later CTA owners, hence have no cycle.
Phase A uses nonwaiting last-contributor completion; all phase-B input dependencies therefore eventually become available if all producers can progress.
limits: Abstract schedule proof, not a test of the candidate's actual CUDA source.
Assumes every grid CTA can become resident; actual occupancy and PDL admission still require separate verification.
Does not establish mbarrier byte counts, asynchronous shared-memory lifetimes, numerical correctness or speed.
GPU ordering and progress depend on the exact release/acquire and deferred-publication implementation.
